case_definition.flow: 2-D Taylor-Green vortex, doubly periodic, extended uniformly in z
case_definition.velocity: u=sin x cos y exp(-2 nu t), v=-cos x sin y exp(-2 nu t)
case_definition.pressure: p = rho/4 (cos 2x + cos 2y) exp(-4 nu t)
case_definition.kinetic_energy: E = rho V / 4 exp(-4 nu t)
case_definition.vorticity: omega_z = 2 sin x sin y exp(-2 nu t)

limit_case.name: limit-high-re
limit_case.reynolds_definition: U L / nu with U = 1 m/s and L = 2 pi m (box side)
